galaxyMethod: Colour-preserving seeded radiance-weighted noise dither; each sample is a single real3D point. LMC/SMC/M31/M33 sky patches excluded, no external-galaxy distance particles. Disc/bulge/arm depths inherited by angular cell from the established model.
photometry: Nearby sizes and glow intensities are visual weights from catalogue kind and distance, not calibrated apparent magnitudes. Hipparcos/named glow support14x original (comparable to solar marker); Gaia support5x. Soft halo tapers to zero at support edge.
projection: Galactic equirectangular, longitude increases left, latitude north up; Sun at origin; point position=ray/inverseDistanceKpc.
kernel: Galaxy exp(-4r²), nearby (.7exp(-12r²)+.3exp(-3r²)) with a smooth edge taper over r²=.64..1, circular unit-support; identical CPU atlas and GPU live equations; additive RGB clamped after accumulation.
limitation: 8-bit atlas quantisation and bilinear texture filtering introduce subtexel differences from live rasterization; matching attributes and angular footprints are exact.
